_comment: Hand-maintained values the wiki does not have. Each block notes its source. Edit freely; the nightly build merges this over wiki data.

hiveMind._source: community datamine (single source, unverified) via droidtycoonhelper / dubtrackr, v1.36.2

chipCosts._source: droidtycoonhelper droids.json + dubtrackr chip station guide (v1.38). Steps: default→gold, gold→diamond, … stellar→kyber

initialSlots._source: Slots available before rebirth 1. You don't start with astromech/battle slots (user, 2026-11-11), but the wiki, droid-tycoon.pages.dev and tycoon-tools all agree rebirths only add 7 worker / 6 astromech / 9 battle, while the game max is 11 / 9 / 11. The gap (4 / 3 / 2) is most likely bought with credits during the first run: the wiki says the shipyard and firing range must be bought before the rebirth station. Inferred, not confirmed.

extraSlotUnlocks._source: Slot unlocks the wiki's (outdated) rebirth table is missing. Add { "level": <rebirth>, "area": "worker|astromech|battle" } once known. The wiki currently accounts for 7 worker, 6 astromech and 9 battle unlocks, so 3 astromech and 2 battle are still unplaced.

maxSlots._source: In-game maximum earning slots, confirmed by user 2026-11-11. The build warns if wiki unlocks + initialSlots disagree.

requirementLocations._source: wiki: droids must be in base or lounge. Chip station assumed to count (unverified).
